# Donald Trump’s Approval Rating Falls Below 30% For First Time Ever

Published

Sep 21, 2026 at 10:34 AM EDT

updated

Sep 21, 2026 at 01:09 PM EDT

Dan Gooding

Associate News Editor

President Donald Trump's approval rating dropped below 30 percent for the first time across both his White House terms Monday, as the midterms draw closer. [...] By comparison, other recent polls have generally shown Trump with approval in the mid-to-high 30s, although that has differed depending on policy areas.

The last time a president's approval was in the 20s was President George W. Bush at the end of 2008, per Gallup's presidential approval tracker.

Newsweek reached out to the White House for comment
